_comment: Catalogue of optional CARE apps (frontend plugins) that the Apps tab in CARE
Desktop can turn on and off for staff.
This file does NOT record which apps are on. That lives only in CARE's own
plug_config table — the same rows CARE's Apps admin page (http://care.local/
admin/apps) edits — so the panel and that page can never disagree.
Each entry:
slug         required. Must match the plugin's own slug (its repo name).
name         what staff see in the panel.
description  one plain sentence: what it does for them, not how it works.
bundle       folder inside the facility-bucket holding the built plugin,
e.g. 'apps/care_hello_fe'. Served offline at
http://care.local/facility-bucket/<bundle>/ via Caddy.
url          optional. A full remoteEntry.js URL, for clinics with internet
that load the app from a CDN instead. Overrides 'bundle'.
remote_entry optional. Defaults to 'assets/remoteEntry.js'.
needs_backend_plug  optional. Name of the Django plug this app also needs;
set it and the panel warns that `care rebuild-backend` is
required, which needs internet and several minutes.
To install a bundle onto an offline clinic box:
docker compose exec -T minio mc cp --recursive \
--attr 'Content-Type=text/javascript' \
/path/to/plugin/dist/ local/facility-bucket/apps/<slug>/
The Content-Type matters: the browser loads the plugin as an ES module and
refuses anything MinIO labels application/octet-stream.

apps.name: Hello World (sample)
apps.description: A demo add-on used to check that optional apps load correctly. Safe to leave off.
